# Mishpacha Tours, Jewish Tours of Lyon

> Private, strictly kosher guided tours of Jewish Lyon, France, led by a Jewish, observant, state-licensed guide-conferencier. The only tour that goes inside the Grande Synagogue of Lyon (quai Tilsitt, 1864), by a special authorisation that Mishpacha Tours holds; the building is closed to visitors outside the Heritage Days. Five tours: Jewish Lyon (2.5 h), Memory CHRD, Memory Montluc and Neveh Shalom, Stopover (3 h, between the airport and the Alps), Izieu day trip. Tours in English, French or Spanish (Hebrew-speaking guests are guided in English), per group, never on Shabbat or Jewish holidays. Bookings by WhatsApp +33 7 67 71 12 59 or contact@mishpachatours.com.

Key facts: tours priced per group (Jewish Lyon from 290 EUR for 1 to 4 people); free cancellation up to 24 hours before; every tour is run as a secured tour (private group, discreet routes fixed in advance, guide from the community) with a professional security escort on request, priced separately; the site also documents the kosher restaurants, synagogues, Chabad houses, mikvaot and Shabbat logistics of Lyon and Villeurbanne, and the Jewish communities and kosher options of the French Alps (Grenoble, Aix-les-Bains, Annecy, Courchevel, Megeve). Facts are sourced and dated on each page; verify hours and prices before travelling.

## Tours

- [Izieu, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/izieu/): A full day at the Maison d'Izieu, one hour from Lyon. Private, strictly kosher, from 990 € quote on request. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Jewish Lyon, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/jewish-lyon/): A private walk through the Jewish story of Lyon, inside the Grande Synagogue. Private, strictly kosher, 290 € per group, 1 to 4 people. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Memory: the CHRD, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/memory-chrd/): A private visit of the Centre d'histoire de la résistance et de la déportation. Private, strictly kosher, 290 € per group, 1 to 4 people. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Memory: Montluc and Neveh Shalom](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/memory-montluc-neveh-shalom/): The Montluc memorial, then the second synagogue we take you inside. Private, strictly kosher, 290 € per group, 1 to 4 people. Book on WhatsApp.
- [Stopover, private Jewish tour of Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/tours/stopover/): Three hours in Jewish Lyon while your transfer waits. Private, strictly kosher, 390 € per group, 1 to 5 people. Book on WhatsApp.

## Practical guides: kosher, synagogues, Shabbat, Chabad, mikveh, hotels

- [Chabad houses in Lyon, Villeurbanne and Écully](https://mishpachatours.com/chabad-lyon/): The seven Chabad centres of Lyon and Villeurbanne, with addresses and phones. Shabbat meals and minyan on request. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Grande Synagogue of Lyon: Visit Quai Tilsitt, 1864](https://mishpachatours.com/grande-synagogue-lyon/): The Grande Synagogue of Lyon, built 1864, is closed to visitors outside the Heritage Days. See how to get in, the prayer times and the address.
- [Is Lyon safe for Jewish visitors? Our standard](https://mishpachatours.com/is-lyon-safe-for-jewish-visitors/): How Mishpacha Tours secures its private Jewish tours of Lyon: discreet routes, a guide from the community, security escort on request. The sourced facts.
- [The Jewish cemetery of Lyon (La Mouche)](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-cemetery-lyon/): Address, hours and contact of the cimetière israélite de la Mouche in Lyon, founded 1795, run by the Consistoire. How to find a family grave. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Jewish Lyon in two days, a kosher itinerary](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-lyon-itinerary-2-days/): A two-day Jewish itinerary for Lyon: the Grande Synagogue and rue Juiverie on day one, the CHRD or Montluc on day two, kosher meals and Shabbat planned in.
- [Jewish travel to Lyon: the honest FAQ](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-travel-lyon-faq/): Nineteen straight answers for a Jewish traveller to Lyon: getting there, kosher, Shabbat, security, prayer and our private tours. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Kosher restaurants in Lyon and Villeurbanne](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-restaurants-lyon/): 36 kosher restaurants, bakeries, butchers, groceries and caterers in Lyon, Villeurbanne and Écully, all on the official Beth Din de Lyon list. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Kosher catering and Shabbat meals in Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-shabbat-meals-catering-lyon/): Seven caterers certified by the Beth Din de Lyon, Chabad Shabbat meals and kosher groceries for a Shabbat in an apartment. How to order before you land.
- [Kosher ski holidays in the French Alps, via Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/kosher-ski-holidays-french-alps/): Kosher ski in the French Alps: Chabad minyanim in Courchevel and Megève, kosher programs by resort, Shabbat on the mountain, and Lyon as your first stop.
- [Lyon, gateway to the Alps for Jewish travellers](https://mishpachatours.com/lyon-gateway-to-the-alps-kosher/): Flying to Lyon for a kosher ski week? Drive times to 13 resorts, airport shuttles, where to buy kosher food before you go up, and a 3 hour Jewish Lyon stopover.
- [Mikveh in Lyon and Villeurbanne: addresses, contacts](https://mishpachatours.com/mikveh-lyon/): Eight mikvahs in Lyon and Villeurbanne with addresses and phones. Mikvah Haya Mouchka, 60 rue Crillon, is listed as open nightly. How to ask before you travel.
- [Shabbat in Lyon: synagogues, meals, where to stay](https://mishpachatours.com/shabbat-in-lyon/): Spending Shabbat in Lyon: where to pray, how to eat, where to sleep on foot, what closes on Friday and what to ask before you go. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Synagogues in Lyon, prayer times and Shabbat](https://mishpachatours.com/synagogues-lyon/): The Grande Synagogue de Lyon, Neveh Chalom and 26 minyanim in Lyon and Villeurbanne: addresses, phones, prayer times. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Where to stay in Lyon as a Jewish traveller: 3 areas](https://mishpachatours.com/where-to-stay-lyon-jewish-travellers/): Three areas to sleep in Lyon when you keep Shabbat: Presqu'île, 6th arrondissement, Villeurbanne. Walking estimates to Tilsitt and the questions to ask a hotel.

## Places and memory: Grande Synagogue, rue Juiverie, CHRD, Montluc, Izieu, history

- [CHRD Lyon: Resistance and deportation museum, visit](https://mishpachatours.com/chrd-lyon/): The CHRD in Lyon, in the former Gestapo headquarters: what you see, the Jewish history it tells, hours, prices, tram access and our private guided visit.
- [Jewish history of Lyon, Middle Ages to today](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-history-lyon/): Jewish history of Lyon from the medieval Juiverie to the Resistance, the Barbie trial and today's community, plus the places you can visit in Lyon.
- [Maison d'Izieu: hours, prices, visit from Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/maison-izieu/): The Maison d'Izieu, memorial to the Jewish children arrested on 6 April 1944: history, hours, prices, the guided house visit and the trip from Lyon.
- [Montluc prison memorial, Lyon: visit, hours, history](https://mishpachatours.com/montluc-prison-lyon/): The Montluc prison memorial in Lyon: free entry, the history of the Jews held there in 1943 and 1944, the Izieu children, access, and the synagogue nearby.
- [Rue Juiverie, Lyon: Medieval Jewish Quarter Tour](https://mishpachatours.com/rue-juiverie-lyon/): Rue Juiverie in Vieux Lyon kept its name from the medieval Jewish community. What remains, what does not, and how to visit with a Jewish guide.

## Alps and region

- [Jewish life around Lyon and in the Alps](https://mishpachatours.com/jewish-life-around-lyon/): Synagogues and Chabad houses in Grenoble, Annecy, Aix-les-Bains, Chambéry, Valence and Clermont-Ferrand, winter minyanim in Courchevel and Megève. Checked 7 October 2026.
- [Summer in the Alps for Jewish families, via Lyon](https://mishpachatours.com/summer-in-the-alps-jewish-families/): Kosher summer in the French Alps: synagogues, mikveh and meals in Aix-les-Bains, Annecy and Grenoble, what is published for Chamonix, and Lyon as your base.
